ios.desc: Packed with humor, puns and goofy parodies, this game will make you question everything you thought you knew about golf! It is a silly physics-based golf parody where each level is a new surprising type of golf. Some brilliant or hilarious, others so absurd you will ask yourself: WHAT THE GOLF?IT’S REALLY NOT GOLFBut it’s a lot of other things! Cats, couches, horses, cars, TV’s, tennis, dogs, flags, flying houses, a fax machine… You name it, we golf it!EXPLORE THE LABWhat has happened in the golf lab? Why is it called a hole-in-one and not a house-in-one? Are there really no limits to what you can golf?WANT MORE? WE GOT YOUNew episodes dropping/released often, you can already check out:It’s Snowtime: An epic adventure of frozen pizza and pineappleA Hole New World: Golf, now with holes!Sporty Sports: Where all the sports are golf!…and many more to come!Updates for special  holidays, including:International Cat Day (Catch the laser!)Halloween (A tricky little treat)World Maritime Day (That one was “aboat" time)Thanksgiving (Because turkeys are the only birdies you need!)Valentines Day (A love story between a horse and a golf ball)…and more!DISCLAIMER!!This game is made by people who know nothing about golf. It will NOT make you a better golf player!

quotes.text:
Lego Builder’s Journey is an excellent game that can be enjoyed by adults.

https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/lego-builders-journey/id1441636691

What the Golf is great fun for all ages.

https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/what-the-golf/id1415190483

Simon’s Cat is a fun puzzle game. Kids love the story and the puzzles are challenging enough to be enjoyed by adults.

https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/simons-cat-story-time/id1535011471

Mini Motorways is sublime

https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/mini-motorways/id1453901000

Sneaky Sasquatch and Alba are fun RPG lite adventures that you can play with younger kids to help them navigate more complex game experiences.

https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/sneaky-sasquatch/id1098342019

https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/alba-a-wildlife-adventure/id1528014682

Assemble with Care is a lovely puzzle game about repairing with a nice narrative.

https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/assemble-with-care/id1450498694

There are more but most of these keep my kids coming back and it’s a way to engage with them that you don’t often get in other games.
